items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I played with them until, I believe about, when we started, when we started with Desd. 29. In 29. In 28. 28. But we left town in 29.

ctx.x: I know that name. I hear that. Yeah. Or Ryan Lewand, the same style of talk. Yeah. That's right. Uh, so, tell me a little bit more. Did you play on regular stedal drums or were you just called it?

Oh no, just beatin' around. Mm-hmm. You never played drum with no band? No. Uh-uh. Just be all the musicians. That's right. And the family. It's amusement. All right. And then after that, I started picking up ukulele. Mm-hmm. Played ukulele round and about till one of the bands picked me up and told me I had to get a banjo. They wanted to. What band that was picked? That was, uh, Go Get Em. Go Get Em. Yeah. Oscar Collins and Paul Maurice. From over here? Yeah. Still in bass. At least they both did now. And I…

Did anybody in your family play to help you? Nobody in your family? Just signed? Just gifted, that's right, I guess. You just picked it up on your own? Picked it up on your own. No teacher? No teacher at all at that time.
